text:
Kyoto-billing-bot: New invoice received from Kyoto Consulting — INV-2026-342, total $12,450. Attached: scan (link)
Maria: FYI vendor sent an invoice but there's no PO on our side. vendor says PO 2026-KY-88 but that doesn't exist in Coupa.
Sanjay: @Maria can you paste the PDF link? I'll check contract notes.
Maria: https://files.redwood/attachments/inv_INV-2026-342.pdf — scanned header shows PO: 2026-KY-88, but AP can't match.
Elaine: We have a pending SOW with Kyoto (Ravi negotiated), but procurement never created a blanket PO. Invoice is for a one-off milestone payment. We need an approver and GL.
Ravi: That's from the APAC infra audit engagement — I approved the SOW but forgot to route PO. Sorry, my bad. Approver should be @Ravi or @Sanjay?
Sanjay: Approver for that project is @Ravi for scope, but finance needs a formal PO number. Elaine, can AP create a retro PO or do we need a manual voucher? :thinking_face:
Elaine: We can do a manual voucher (code MV) for < $15k but need a 2nd approval from Finance Lead. Can we get a confirm email from Ravi approving the spend and GL 5401?
Ravi: Confirmed — approved. Charge GL 5401 (Professional Services). Happy for AP to proceed with manual voucher.
Maria: @Elaine i'll attach Ravi's approval to the invoice and start voucher. Also vendor requests expedited payment; can we fast-track?
Elaine: If we route to Finance Lead (Matt) with the voucher and approval note, we can do 5-7 business days. I'll ping Matt.
Maria: pinging @Matt (finance-lead) — Matt, need quick approval for manual voucher for Kyoto Consulting INV-2026-342, $12,450, GL 5401. Ravi approved in thread.
Matt (Finance Lead): looks good, approve for manual voucher. Please include vendor remit instructions and tax form.
Kyoto-billing-bot: Vendor remit on file: Kyoto Consulting Ltd — bank transfer ACH JP; tax form pending.
Elaine: Got it. I'll attach remit and request vendor to resend W-8/W-9 variant for our records. Processing voucher now.
Sanjay: Quick note — can procurement retro-fit a PO for tracking? Helps for month-end reporting.
Ravi: Yes, I'll create a retro PO 2026-KY-R88 and link it to the expense after voucher clears.
Maria: Thanks team. Closing loop: voucher created, queued for payment after vendor tax form is uploaded. @Kyoto-billing-bot please mark invoice status: pending-tax. :white_check_mark:
Kyoto-billing-bot: Invoice INV-2026-342 status updated to pending-tax. Payment hold until tax doc received.
